description: This file defines the AttendanceRecordAPI class, a REST API endpoint for managing attendance records, including retrieving and updating individual records, with detailed validation and permission checks.

classes.name: AttendanceRecordAPI
classes.description: A REST API class for managing attendance records, supporting retrieval and modification of individual attendance records with permission and validation logic.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieve a specific attendance record by ID, validating access permissions.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Update an existing attendance record with new punch-in/out times and notes, performing overlap checks and permission validation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented; intended for deleting attendance records.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validation rules specific for the getOne request.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules specific for the update request of an attendance record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rules for delete operation, currently not implemented.

methods.name: isAuthUserAllowedToPerformTheActions
methods.description: Checks whether the authenticated user has permission to perform actions on a specific attendance record.

methods.name: setAttendanceRecord
methods.description: Sets the punch-in and punch-out times and notes on the attendance record, performing overlap checks and timezone validation.

methods.name: getRequestBodyParams
methods.description: Extracts punch-in/out data from request body parameters.

methods.name: extractPunchDateTime
methods.description: Creates a DateTime object from a date-time string and timezone offset.

methods.name: isAllowedToEditTimezone
methods.description: Validates whether the user is permitted to edit timezone details based on provided offset and name.
